test_title: PYST 3: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 16 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A - B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

If P × M ÷ S × R - T + Q, then which of the following statements is NOT correct?

options.text: R is the father of Q.
P is T’s father’s mother’s sister.
S is the mother of Q.

solution: • ‘A + B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’. • ‘A - B’ means ‘A is the father of B’. • ‘A × B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’. • ‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.
